<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: right"><B>Exhibit&nbsp;99.1</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: center; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt">&nbsp;<IMG SRC="tm2619098d1_ex99-1img001.jpg" ALT=""></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center"><B>
MOBILITY GLOBAL INC. COMPLETES SEPARATION FROM S&amp;P GLOBAL INC. AND BEGINS TRADING ON THE NEW YORK STOCK EXCHANGE AS A GLOBAL LEADER
IN AUTOMOTIVE DATA&nbsp;&amp; ANALYTICS</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: left; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B>NEW YORK, JULY 1, 2026 &ndash; </B>Mobility Global Inc. (NYSE: MBGL)
announced today that it has completed its separation from S&amp;P Global Inc. and is now an independent, public company. Mobility Global
shares will begin trading today on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker symbol &ldquo;MBGL.&rdquo;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&ldquo;For over 100 years, we have had the honor of serving the automotive
industry. As Mobility Global, we continue our mission of providing trusted information that fuels better decisions in this fast-moving
sector,&rdquo; said <B>Bill Eager</B>, Chief Executive Officer of Mobility Global. &ldquo;Our powerful brands &ndash; CARFAX, automotiveMastermind,
Polk Automotive Solutions, and Market Scan &ndash; help people make better decisions with unique industry-leading information.&nbsp; As
the many changes across the automotive industry continue, our data, our AI capabilities and, most importantly, our people will meet the
growing demand for must-have information that helps automotive manufacturers, suppliers, dealers and consumers.&rdquo;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: left">&ldquo;Mobility Global begins from a position
of financial strength, built on our powerful brands, trusted data, and deep, long-standing customer relationships,&quot; said <B>Matt
Calderone</B>, Chief Financial Officer of Mobility Global. &ldquo;This foundation is what allows us to keep innovating in market-leading
products, technology, and talent. As an independent, publicly traded company, we can further tailor our growth strategy, financial profile,
and investments to the specific needs of the Mobility business and its customers.&rdquo;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: left">&ldquo;I've spent my career in this industry,
and the decisions facing automotive manufacturers, dealers, and suppliers today are more complex and consequential than ever before,&quot;
said <B>Joe Hinrichs</B>, Chairman of the Board of Mobility Global. &ldquo;In this environment, trusted information is essential. Mobility
Global is uniquely positioned to provide solutions, backed by a century of credibility and brands the industry relies on. On behalf of
the Board,&nbsp;I&rsquo;m proud of our leadership, our teams, and our mission, and I am confident in our ability to help shape the future
of mobility.&rdquo;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">The separation was achieved through the distribution of 100 percent
of the shares of Mobility Global to holders of S&amp;P Global common stock effective as of 12:01 a.m.&nbsp;New York City time on July&nbsp;1,
2026, with S&amp;P Global stockholders receiving one share of Mobility Global common stock for every share of S&amp;P Global common stock
held at the close of business on June&nbsp;15, 2026, the record date. S&amp;P Global stockholders entitled to receive the distribution
received a book-entry account statement or a credit to their brokerage account reflecting their ownership of Mobility Global common stock.
Fractional shares of Mobility Global common stock were not distributed. Any fractional share of Mobility Global common stock otherwise
issuable to a S&amp;P Global stockholder will be sold in the open market on such stockholder&rsquo;s behalf, and such stockholder will
receive a cash payment for the fractional share based on its pro rata portion of the net cash proceeds from all sales of fractional shares.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><B><U>About Mobility Global</U></B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">Mobility Global is the world&rsquo;s standard for automotive information,
providing critical data and analytics across the full vehicle lifecycle. Its portfolio of trusted brands and products includes CARFAX,
automotiveMastermind, Polk Automotive Solutions, and Market Scan, supporting the world&rsquo;s major automotive manufacturers, suppliers,
dealer groups, media, financial institutions, and consumers with data, forecasts, insights, technology, and innovation. For more information,
visit mobilityglobal.com.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">This press release contains &ldquo;forward-looking statements,&rdquo;
as defined in the Private Securities Litigation Reform Act of 1995. These statements, which express management&rsquo;s current views concerning
future events, trends, contingencies or results, appear at various places in this press release and use words like &ldquo;anticipate,&rdquo;
 &ldquo;assume,&rdquo; &ldquo;believe,&rdquo; &ldquo;continue,&rdquo; &ldquo;estimate,&rdquo; &ldquo;expect,&rdquo; &ldquo;forecast,&rdquo;
 &ldquo;future,&rdquo; &ldquo;intend,&rdquo; &ldquo;plan,&rdquo; &ldquo;potential,&rdquo; &ldquo;predict,&rdquo; &ldquo;project,&rdquo;
 &ldquo;strategy,&rdquo; &ldquo;target&rdquo; and similar terms, and future or conditional tense verbs like &ldquo;could,&rdquo; &ldquo;may,&rdquo;
 &ldquo;might,&rdquo; &ldquo;should,&rdquo; &ldquo;will&rdquo; and &ldquo;would.&rdquo; For example, management may use forward-looking
statements when addressing topics such as: the outcome of contingencies; future actions by regulators; changes in the business strategies

services and products; the expected impact of acquisitions and dispositions; the Company&rsquo;s effective tax rates; the Company&rsquo;s
cost structure, dividend policy, cash flows or liquidity.</P>

tax purposes, S&amp;P Global and/or holders of S&amp;P Global common stock could be subject to significant tax liabilities. In certain

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">The factors noted above are not exhaustive. The Company and its subsidiaries

undue reliance on any forward-looking statements, which speak only as of the dates on which they are made. The Company undertakes no obligation
to update or revise any forward-looking statement to reflect events or circumstances arising after the date on which it is made, except
as required by applicable law. Further information about the Company&rsquo;s businesses, including information about factors that could
materially affect its results of operations and financial condition, is contained in the Company&rsquo;s filings with the SEC, including,
the section titled &ldquo;Risk Factors&rdquo; of the Information Statement, dated May&nbsp;27, 2026, filed as Exhibit&nbsp;99.1 to the
Company&rsquo;s Form&nbsp;10 with the SEC on May&nbsp;27, 2026.</P>
